solver_answer.answer: Potentially, yes. A bigger Saturday-evening hosting role could be a risk if it leaves you socially depleted or reduces preparation time before your already-booked Sunday mediation check-in, which requires patient one-to-one listening. The memory does not establish that you could not do both, but it supports checking the gathering’s workload, end time, and whether you can protect recovery time or decline/scale back the role.
